learning_objective: 🎯 Travel through time by mastering the Present, Past, and Future tenses to tell stories with perfect timing!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Tenses are like magical time machines for your verbs. They change the form of the verb to tell the reader exactly WHEN an action is happening in time!
The Present tense is for things happening right now or things you do every day as a habit. 'I eat an apple' (Simple Present) or 'I am eating an apple' (Present Continuous).
The Past tense is for actions that have already finished and are completely over. 'I played football yesterday' (Simple Past) or 'I was playing football when it rained' (Past Continuous).
The Future tense is used for dreams, plans, and actions that have not happened yet! We use helper words like 'will' or 'shall'. Example: 'I will travel to the moon!'

fun_activity.title: 📖 The Time Traveler's Diary
fun_activity.instructions: Write three sentences about your favorite meal. One in the Past Tense (what you ate yesterday), one in the Present (what you are eating now), and one in the Future (what you will eat tomorrow)!

quick_recap: ⭐ Tenses are different verb forms that clearly show the exact time an action takes place.
⭐ English grammar has three main tenses: Past (yesterday), Present (today), and Future (tomorrow).
